additions.note: Hosted flagship with native vision, 1M context and a 2.4T-parameter mixture-of-experts backbone with 71B active per token. Available through QwenCloud API and Token Plan, QwenWork and QwenStudio, following the November 11 preview; smaller open-weight Qwen4 models are planned separately.

Hosted multimodal model for everyday agent workflows, with 224B total parameters (including 64B Engram parameters), 12B active and up to 1M context. Available through Tencent Cloud TokenHub and Tencent apps; OpenRouter integration and public weights are planned.

Restricted API classifier for approved organizations, providing separate scores for potential CSAM and AI-generated CSAM to prioritize human review. Available at no cost through the moderations endpoint as omni-moderation-csam-latest.

Open-weight audio-driven avatar update with more natural lip, face and body motion and improved long-video consistency. Builds on Avatar 1.5 with distilled LoRA checkpoints; publisher reports generation exceeding ten minutes.

Apache-2.0 multimodal mixture-of-experts checkpoint with approximately 187.8B total parameters and 262,144-token configured context. Public BF16 weights, tokenizer, custom Transformers implementation and image/video processors support local text generation and visual understanding. Published benchmark scores are vendor supplied.

Apache-2.0 pretrained speech-to-speech base model for research, built on Qwen3.5-4B. Listens and speaks simultaneously in nine primary languages, with text character prompts and reference-audio voice control. Public weights and inference implementations support PyTorch, MLX and vLLM-Omni; this is a base model rather than a finished assistant.

Hosted native multimodal reasoning model with 560B total and 25B active parameters, 1M context and text, image and video input. Available through Ant Ling chat and OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible APIs; targets visual understanding and long-horizon agent tasks. OpenRouter listed a free text/image endpoint on November 13; public downloadable weights were not established.
